usage: Invalid identity documents that MUST fail pin validation (records.md §5.1, §5.3 P-0).

cases.name: id-with-query
cases.description: Identity document id carries a query string, which §5.1 forbids.

cases.name: id-with-empty-query
cases.description: Identity document id ends with a trailing ?, which §5.1 forbids even though WHATWG .search is empty.

cases.name: id-with-empty-fragment
cases.description: Identity document id ends with a trailing #, which §5.1 forbids even though WHATWG .hash is empty.

cases.name: id-uppercase-host
cases.description: Identity document id host has an uppercase letter, which K-1 forbids.

cases.name: id-default-port
cases.description: Identity document id writes out default port :443, which K-1 forbids.

cases.name: darep-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for document member darep.

cases.name: id-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for document member id.

cases.name: addresses-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for document member addresses.

cases.name: updated-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for document member updated.

cases.name: keys-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for document member keys.

cases.name: keys-empty
cases.description: A pin must contain at least one key.

cases.name: key-not-object
cases.description: Each key must be an object.

cases.name: addresses-empty
cases.description: A pin must contain at least one address.

cases.name: address-wrong-type
cases.description: Every address must be a string.

cases.name: address-newline
cases.description: An address cannot end in a line break.

cases.name: key-id-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for key member id.

cases.name: key-purpose-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for key member purpose.

cases.name: key-publicKeyJwk-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for key member publicKeyJwk.

cases.name: key-validFrom-wrong-type
cases.description: Wrong type for key member validFrom.

cases.name: key-id-other-document
cases.description: A key id must belong to its document.

cases.name: key-id-empty-fragment
cases.description: Key fragments must not be empty.

cases.name: key-id-long-fragment
cases.description: Key fragments are at most 64 characters.

cases.name: key-id-newline
cases.description: Key fragments cannot end in a line break.

cases.name: validUntil-equal
cases.description: validUntil must be later than validFrom.

cases.name: validUntil-before
cases.description: validUntil must be later than validFrom.

cases.name: validUntil-invalid-before-epoch
cases.description: Invalid validUntil is invalid even for a pre-epoch key.

cases.name: jwk-private
cases.description: A public JWK must not contain d.

cases.name: jwk-x-noncanonical
cases.description: JWK coordinate pad bits must be zero.

cases.name: jwk-y-noncanonical
cases.description: JWK coordinate pad bits must be zero.
